accounting_policy.historical_annual_scaffold: Zaloga 2007 family-by-family calendar-year table is used as the common cross-type accounting scaffold because it is internally consistent across AFV families.
accounting_policy.source_conflict_policy: Do not average incompatible series. Sagami/postwar figures are retained as an alternative acceptance/fiscal/repair series until original tables are transcribed.
accounting_policy.monthly_values: RECONSTRUCTED MODEL CURVE, NOT ARCHIVAL MONTHLY PRODUCTION. Annual totals are hard anchors; monthly allocation is only a working ramp for event timing.
accounting_policy.branch_extra_hulls: ZERO released at opening pending factory/engine/armor-plate audit. The Branch 1941 steel delta (+1.5 to +3%) is not converted automatically into tank hulls.
accounting_policy.retrofit_counting: Shinhoto retrofit of existing Type97 hulls changes model mix but does not add a new hull to national physical inventory.

Type95_HaGo.series_note: Zaloga scaffold; total through 1941 = 1,406 in this series.

Type97_ChiHa_57mm.series_note: Zaloga scaffold; 1942 has a final 28 before new-turret production dominates.

Type97_source_conflict.interpretation: These likely mix calendar/fiscal year, new production, acceptance, repair/conversion and incomplete factory coverage. They are not directly interchangeable.

Shinhoto_1941.trial_line: 47mm turret/gun trials were already active in 1940-41.
Shinhoto_1941.historical_deployment_at_1941_12_opening: 0 centered; historical secondary synthesis says not deployed at expansion of war.
Shinhoto_1941.historical_first_combat: Philippines 1942 replacement/temporary company; two vehicles at Corregidor are a hard later anchor.

branch_1935_1940.1935_1938: No quantity inflation. Improvement enters prototype comparison, tolerance, reliability, acceptance and repairability.
branch_1935_1940.1939_Nomonhan: Strategic result unchanged. Mechanized-force value is remembered more positively because recoverability/dispatchability are better; 47mm and armored-formation pressure remains at least historical.
branch_1935_1940.1940: Use historical family quantities until factory audit. Branch changes quality/acceptance and slightly accelerates 47mm turret integration, not mass hull output.

branch_1941_new_production.policy: Use historical scaffold quantities as provisional physical new-build totals. Any extra new hulls require a later factory-resource ledger.

branch_1941_Shinhoto_retrofit.causal_change: Branch test closure, tolerance control and acceptance shorten the already-historical 68-hull retrofit program. No new concept is invented.
branch_1941_Shinhoto_retrofit.authorization_working: 1941-08 or early 1941-09 equivalent; production preparation begins immediately after final practical trials.

Southern_Army_embarked_combat_deployed.reason: Southern invasion tank OOB and shipping plans were already fixed; 7th Tank Regiment in Luzon used Type89/Type95 and 4th was a light regiment. No evidence supports magically replacing their embarked tanks at the last minute.

home_Kwantung_school_depot_pool.interpretation: Accepted vehicles remain mainly in Japan/training/depot/anti-Soviet allocation until a dated issue/shipping decision is paid.

year_end.next_batch: A second retrofit/new-build transition batch may begin in early 1942, but is not yet booked.

Type1_ChiHe.branch_effect: design/engine/welding process work may be cleaner, but successful ChiHa/Shinhoto reduces the need for a crash production switch.

Type1_HoNiI.reason: historical program starts June 1941; Branch may close evaluation somewhat faster, but no evidence supports opening-war operational deployment.

Type98_KeNi.state: 1 historical new-build scaffold vehicle only; no priority surge
Type98_KeNi.reason: Ha-Go was already considered adequate historically; a more reliable Branch Ha-Go makes a production switch no more urgent.

Type1_47mm_AT.quantity: OPEN; total-war production ~2,300 is known, but annual 1941-42 split is not yet securely sourced.
Type1_47mm_AT.guard: Do not steal an undefined number of guns from Shinhoto turrets or vice versa until Osaka Arsenal gun-production ledger is reconstructed.

opening_effect.immediate_1941_12_campaign_change: Small. Shinhoto exists physically/accepted at home but is not centered in the embarked Southern Army tank OOB on 7 Dec.
opening_effect.first_retroactive_combat_gate: Replacement shipments to Philippines/Malaya/Burma after opening; the historical Corregidor Shinhoto arrival is a later anchor that may be accelerated/enlarged.
opening_effect.major_future_effect: 1942 production mix and tank-regiment re-equipment, not Pearl Harbor-week order of battle.

unresolved_required_next: Transcribe or otherwise reconstruct the Sagami/JACAR 1941-45 factory-by-factory table, especially Type97 categories and repairs.
Reconstruct Osaka Arsenal Type1 47mm gun/tank-gun production and turret output.
Close 1942 monthly Type97 57mm -> Shinhoto new-build/retrofit transition.
Close 1942 Type95 output and whether successful Branch Ha-Go delays Ke-Ni further.
Close Ho-Ni I 1942 monthly production and allocation.
After 1942 production is fixed, re-run Philippines/Malaya/Burma only where vehicle mix actually changes.
